company.name: PlayVS
company.shortDescription: PlayVS operates an eSports platform to organize high school and collegiate esports.
company.description: PlayVS is an operator of an eSports platform used to organize competitions in eSports on behalf of high school. Its platform offers to organize online tournaments and wagers for cash and prizes and helps to play and stay up-to-date on high school e-sports programs that enable teen gamers to form teams at their high schools to compete with players from other schools and the battle for titles at state championships.

productsAndServices.description: A competition platform for middle and high schools that organizes esports leagues, tournaments, matches, and community events across the United States and Canada.
productsAndServices.name: PlayVS Scholastic Esports Leagues

productsAndServices.description: A grades 3–12 gaming and esports curriculum that teaches digital literacy, teamwork, strategy, communication, problem-solving, and responsible technology use through classroom-ready lessons.
productsAndServices.name: Gaming Concepts

productsAndServices.description: A collegiate esports league that provides universities and college teams with organized competition, league operations, and access to collegiate esports programming.
productsAndServices.name: PlayVS College League (PCL)

productsAndServices.description: A collegiate esports recruiting service that connects high school esports talent with college programs through player data and recruitment opportunities.
productsAndServices.name: PlayVS Recruit

productsAndServices.description: Esports coaching and player-development services providing structured training, strategy development, drills, feedback, and performance reporting for school esports teams.
productsAndServices.name: PlayVS Coaching Solutions

productsAndServices.description: A curated partner marketplace connecting schools with organizations that provide esports equipment, software, curriculum, coaching, facilities, and program support.
productsAndServices.name: PlayVS Collective
